title: Bear Den TV portable layout (protocol 1)
description: The cosmetic, exportable subset of config.json that the web layout editor and TV settings may change. It never contains launch definitions, remote/network settings, credentials, or device records.

theme.description: Style: den-dark (Bear Den: decorations and bears), plain-dark (Plain: none), performance (Plain with every animation off).

background.description: Theme id (a folder with theme.json; contracts/theme.schema.json). Built in: den, forest, midnight, campfire, winter; older values den-gradient and charcoal are aliases.

art_style.description: Art style: pixel (pixel art on one grid, the default) or classic (smooth vector art and pictures). Independent of theme (Style). Missing means pixel.

app_icons.description: App icons: app (the default: the installed Flatpak's own exported icon, where the Flatpak is the app itself) or bear_den (Bear Den's own drawings). The owner's brand folder wins either way. Missing means app.
